fx.rule: ore/kWh = EUR/MWh x rate / 10, rate = ECB reference rate of the price day, or the latest published before it
fx.source: ECB Statistical Data Warehouse, series EXR/D.SEK.EUR.SP00.A (euro foreign exchange reference rate)

provider: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform (A44 day-ahead prices, A11 physical flows)
selection_note: coverage status and selection verification are separate: selection.verified=false means complete data from a selected series outside its verified period

source.store: A2 local store (not a production store)

status_meaning.COMPLETE: every expected interval of the local day has a selected value
status_meaning.CONFLICT: duplicate source values disagree beyond the rule; conflicting intervals have no value
status_meaning.IN_PROGRESS: flows of the running local day, still being published
status_meaning.MISSING: no value for a day that should be published
status_meaning.PARTIAL: some intervals missing at the source; missing_starts_utc lists them; never filled
